entities.name: Torgaar
entities.description: A famine spirit avatar of Urborg, born of one of its calamities, who terrorizes the Cabal, the swamp spirits and anyone nearby.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: A swampy land on Dominaria home to twisted spirits.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: A Dominarian nation whose campfire stories tell of the spirits of Urborg.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: A group terrorized by Torgaar in the marshes of Urborg.
